info.title: MSC 1 Remote API (compatibility baseline)
info.description: Captured from MSC 1's actual RemoteAPIServer*.swift source per msc2-decisions.md #145: behavior as MSC 1 has it, not aspirational. Built incrementally, one route family per P0.23a-P0.23s step (docs/msc2/rolling-plan.md).

400.description: missing_body / invalid_json / name_required / invalid_server_type / invalid_java_flavor / unsupported_server_type

post.x-notes: Read from RemoteAPIServer+ComponentRoutes.swift handleCreateServer and RemoteAPIServer+HTTP.swift's serverMutationStatus. success/message/serverId/serverName/warnings come back on 200 even though the handler ultimately runs async via createServerProvider.

post.summary: Scan or import an existing server directory/zip/transfer

200.description: action=scan returns ServerImportScanResponseDTO; any other action (importExisting/importTransfer) returns ServerImportResultDTO — same status code, different body shape, dispatched on the request's own 'action' field.

400.description: missing_body / invalid_json / invalid_action / missing_source_path / invalid_path / display_name_required / backup_path_required

post.x-notes: Read from RemoteAPIServer+ComponentRoutes.swift handleImportServer and importStatus. req.action == "scan" routes to serverImportScanProvider; anything else routes to serverImportProvider.

post.summary: Accept the Minecraft EULA for a server
post.x-notes: ServerEULARequestDTO.serverId is itself Optional in the Swift DTO, but handleAcceptServerEULA treats an absent/empty serverId as missing_server_id (400) — so it's required in practice even though the type allows nil.

post.summary: Replace the active world with another slot
Activate a world slot (starts activation asynchronously)
post.x-notes: Unlike the other four /worlds/* mutations, this returns a plain {result: activation_started} object on success, not WorldMutationResultDTO — read directly from RemoteAPIServer+HTTP.swift, not RemoteAPIServer+ComponentRoutes.swift's worldMutationStatus helper.

post.summary: Update a system component (paper/geyser/floodgate) or a Modrinth-tracked add-on
post.x-notes: Three request shapes share one endpoint (RemoteAPIServer+ComponentRoutes.swift handleUpdateComponent): updateAll=true updates every add-on with an available update; jarStem updates one specific add-on; the legacy path (component=paper|geyser|floodgate) updates a system component. The two add-on paths return AddonUpdateResultDTO; the legacy path returns ComponentUpdateResultDTO.

200.description: updateAll/jarStem paths return AddonUpdateResultDTO; the legacy component path returns ComponentUpdateResultDTO
